summary: BifrOSt has a typed intent layer over the app control socket: declared intents with typed parameters, entity queries, IntentResult values with dialog text, and manifest-declared Spotlight shortcuts for parameterless intents. Apple's execution model (foreground/background modes, authentication policy, snippets, enum and common data types, donations, Focus filters, widgets and controls) is not covered; schema domains and presentations are modelled in springboard/sdk/src/intent_presentation.rs, and Siri and Apple Intelligence have no counterpart.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 32 tests. id, title and description are declared and listed by intent.list; no isDiscoverable flag Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 32 tests. Wave 5 (w5-app-intents, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. ParamType has no enum case; predefined value sets cannot be declared

shortcut = true marks an intent as a Spotlight shortcut, and phrases are trimmed, de-duplicated and written to the manifest and the intent JSON, all tested headless. Gap: tile colour and parameter-bearing shortcuts are not modelled, and the shell does not yet read the phrases from the [[intent]] tables in springboard/src/shell/intents.rs.

features.apple: Spotlight integration, App Shortcuts in Spotlight and Shortcuts app
features.note: Parameterless shortcuts are listed, and their request lines and replies are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: the 8 s launch retry, parameter prompts and disambiguation have no tests. Built 2026-10-17: Search lists the Settings intents (settings_intents.rs CATALOGUE) in its Shortcuts section and opens their panes through Settings::open_page_id; tests quicksearch::tests::settings_intents_are_found_as_shortcuts_and_open_their_pane.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs, springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (CSSearchableIndex, CSSearchableItem), springboard/sdk/src/searchable_entity.rs (SearchableEntity, searchable_items); tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-38.rs
features.note: An app value can implement SearchableEntity to build the searchable item the index stores, with its identifiers, attributes, expiry and validation tested headless. Gap: the entity protocol is not tied to App Intents entity queries, a hide-from-search flag is not modelled, and the shell does not index entities yet.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 32 tests. failures return RPC errors with a message; no typed error set and no needs-value or confirmation errors

features.apple: Common data types (Files, Dates, Currencies, Payments, People, Placemarks, Measurements)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 32 tests. Wave 3 (w3-app-intents, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. only the parameter types listed under Intent parameters

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (app-intents, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. apps cannot tell the system which intents were used; no relevance ranking

Wave 5 (w5-app-intents, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model of per-Focus app contexts, the active context and change generations, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-13.rs as well as in the module's unit tests. Not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Focus is a notification switch; apps cannot declare filter intents Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Round (focus-modes): the shell's Focus name is now the active Focus mode's name (Do Not Disturb, Work, Personal, Sleep or a custom one), so apps get the values stored for that mode through the existing changed event; manifest [[focus_filter]] tables (id, title, params) are parsed and checked by parse_declarations in springboard/src/shell/services/focus_filter.rs and tested headless. Not built: the Settings page that sets the values per mode from the declarations, and any app-side SDK declaration path. Not verified on Midget.

The live activity life cycle (scheduled start, stale content, end and dismissal times) is tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: the timeline and control adapters have no tests yet, nothing is wired into the shell or apps, and nothing is run on Midget.

features.apple: App schema domains, visual intelligence, Action button, side button
features.note: Schema domains (a closed set of thirteen categories, read back by name) and presentations (a checked title, subtitle, symbol and domain) are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-16.rs. Gap: no schema registry reads the domains yet, no picker shows the presentation, and the side button and visual search entry points are not built.

features.apple: Siri AI, Apple Intelligence integration, voice
features.note: Apple's assistant and voice stack; BifrOSt's dialog text is not spoken

gaps: Foreground and background execution modes, and authentication policy on AppIntent
App enums (AppEnum) for predefined parameter values
Parameter types for Double, Files, Currencies, People, Placemarks and Measurements
Snippets and result views, and follow-on intents (OpensAppIntent)
Parameter prompts and disambiguation in Spotlight (needsValueError, requestDisambiguation, requestConfirmation)
IndexedEntity: indexing App Intents entities in Spotlight, and hideInSpotlight
Focus filters (SetFocusFilterIntent): manifest [[focus_filter]] declarations are read, but Settings does not yet set the values per Focus mode
Widgets, controls and Live Activities driven by intents
Shortcuts app does not list or run intents yet (docs/bifrost-ui.md, App Intents gaps)
